messages:
auditor_blake: Quick audit ask — need compact, signed evidence for an RBAC adjustment that touched serviceAccount `inference-operator` on 2025-08-04. Deliverables: PR/commit, deploy window, KMS Decrypt events for rdw-inference-key, and any vuln notes. Where do we pull these?

zoe_oncall: Hey @auditor_blake 1 — PR + CI artifact + CloudTrail + k8s audit snippet will cover it. We can bundle.

cody_infra: PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5120, merge commit d4e9b01 (merged 2025-08-04T07:30:12Z). CircleCI job 12109 applied at 2025-08-04T07:30:39Z with `kubectl apply -f rollout-operator-0804.yaml`. CI artifact saved: s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/08/04/deploy-0804-0730.json.

mina_sec: KMS note: query CloudTrail for eventName=Decrypt with keyId or alias matching `rdw-inference-key` between 2025-08-04T07:25:00Z..2025-08-04T07:40:00Z. Our client sets requestParameters.encryptionContext.service_account=inference-operator so that ties decrypts back to the SA. Splunk sample: `index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext`

auditor_blake: Will you redact node hostnames/IPs? Auditor needs ARNs and encryptionContext intact.

cody_infra: Redactions: strip node hostnames and external IPs; keep principal ARNs, encryptionContext, timestamps. I will add checksums.

zoe_oncall: I'll run exporter: `redwood-audit export --from 2025-08-04T07:25:00Z --to 2025-08-04T07:40:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1818181818-operator-handoff-bundle.tar.gz`

evidence-bot: Evidence export started by zoe_oncall. Job eexp-zz42 queued.

mina_sec: vuln note: INFSEC-1428 (linked in PR) 1 patched http-lib minor; no active exploit seen; added monitoring. I'll include `INFSEC-1428-summary.txt` in the bundle.

evidence-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1818181818-operator-handoff-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: 7e5a...)

auditor_blake: Received. Please include a short 10s-resolution timeline.csv that ties merge->CI->pod-start->decrypt events, and an attestation from oncall. I'll review tomorrow and flag gaps. Thanks :thumbsup:

zoe_oncall: Will do. Marking resolved unless you request raw CloudTrail.

auditor_blake: Acknowledged, thanks everyone.
